title: Department of Animal Services report relative to transport vehicle and personnel costs to expand the Department’s ability to host and participate in more…
text:
[Council File 25-1221]
Department of Animal Services report relative to transport vehicle and personnel costs to expand the Department’s ability to host and participate in more Pet Fair events, community resource and health fairs, and other City-sponsored events throughout the City.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For: Studio City Neighborhood Council
summary: Approve funding for Department of Animal Services vehicles and personnel to expand Pet Fair and community health fair events citywide.

outcome.text: Arts, Parks, Libraries, and Community Enrichment Committee approved as amended (Aug 11, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Aug 21, 2026); Council action final
